Quarto callout box

Source: R/co_box.R
co_box.Rd

Writes the markdown for a Quarto callout box. Use it in a chunk with results: asis.

Usage

co_box(
  color,
  header,
  contents = "Your text",
  size = "1.05",
  hsize = "1.10",
  fold = FALSE,
  look = "default"
)

Arguments

color

One of "b" (note), "g" (tip), "r" (important), "o" (warning), or "y" (caution).

header

Callout header text.

contents

Callout body text.

size

Body font size (em).

hsize

Header font size (em).

fold

Logical; collapse the callout?

look

One of "default", "simple", or "minimal".

Value

Called for its side effect: the callout markdown is printed with cat().

Examples

co_box(color = "b", header = "Note", contents = "Some text")
#> 
#> 
#> :::: {.callout-note collapse='false' appearance='default'}
#> 
#> ## [Note]{style='font-weight: bold; font-size: 1.10em;'}
#> 
#> ::: {style='font-size: 1.05em; color: #282b2d;'}
#> 
#> 
#> Some text
#> 
#> ::: 
#> 
#> ::::
